items.title: Jon Hendricks — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Jerry Gonzalez and Fort Apache- he was from that area.

ctx.x: I lived in the Bronx: 201st Street and Gun Hill Road, just this side of White Plains, before it became Fort Apache. It was quite a nice place to live in those days. It was the Bronx, still.
That makes sense. Jerry Gonzalez and Fort Apache- he was from that area.
It’s what Damon Runyan called the Bronix.
